description: Surfaces the portfolio signals overnight, before any question: a delinquency pool outside tolerance, a portfolio nearing a board limit, and building rate and liquidity pressure.
Flags the pool trending outside the aligned delinquency parameter and the payroll group crossing the deposit-outflow trigger.
Answers a plain-language portfolio question across Symitar, the GL, and UST Finex at once, returning one reconciled figure against the board limit.
Models what-if scenarios on the portfolio, including a government-shutdown employment shock, and projects the impact on delinquency, loss, net worth, and liquidity.
Reconciles capital and liquidity across the core, the ledger, and the ALM model so the team can trust the cushion before citing it.
Pulls the pre-set board playbook action for each rate move and fires the SEG attrition alert, with the evidence attached.
